'''Mir-Ki''' was a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] commando stationed at the [[Koss Overlook]] in [[Gormak Lands]]. An outsider brought him the weapons of defeated [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] snipers, for which Mir-Ki expressed his gratitude.
